    PopulationSim Non-GQ Control Preparation¶

    Introduction¶

    This notebook prepares non-group-quarters PopulationSim control totals. It combines ACS demographic controls, housing-unit information, vacancy assumptions, and geography crosswalks into MAZ, block group, tract, and county files used to synthesize the household population.

    Contents¶

    • Configuration, ACS API setup, and shared helper functions
    • ACS-derived controls for age, sex, occupation, workers, children, household size, income, and household type
    • Housing-unit and vacancy-rate controls at MAZ level
    • Allocation of household and person distributions across model geographies
    • Horizontal control-total exports and PopulationSim validation

    Workflow¶

    1. Load configuration and define reusable Census API, validation, and allocation helpers.
    2. Pull ACS tables and convert published categories into PopulationSim control bins.
    3. Build MAZ household and person totals from housing units, vacancy rates, and county population controls.
    4. Distribute demographic and household attributes across block group or tract geographies.
    5. Assemble horizontal control files for MAZ, block group, and tract levels, then run validation when enabled.

    Public Use Notes¶

    • Use environment variables or an ignored local file for Census API credentials.
    • The validation CSVs are intended to document balancing differences and should be reviewed before publishing model inputs.

    PopulationSim Non-GQ control preparation configuration¶

    Loads configuration, resolves input/output paths, and defines shared constants used by the downstream processing cells.

    # PopulationSim Non-GQ control preparation configuration
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.
from os import environ
from pathlib import Path
import time

import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import requests
import yaml


CONFIG_PATH = Path("_config.yaml")
CONFIG = yaml.safe_load(CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

RUN_DATE = environ.get("POPSIM_RUN_DATE", CONFIG["run"]["run_date"])

INPUT_DIR = Path(CONFIG["paths"]["input_dir"])
INPUT_ROOT = INPUT_DIR
OUTPUT_DIR = Path(CONFIG["paths"]["intermediate_dir"]) / RUN_DATE
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
FINAL_OUTPUT_DIR = Path(CONFIG["paths"]["output_dir"])
FINAL_OUTPUT_DIR_ABM_NONGQ = Path(CONFIG["paths"]["abm_non_gq_output_dir"])

YEAR = str(CONFIG["census"]["year"])
state_code = str(CONFIG["census"]["state_code"])
county_fips_dict = {county: str(fips).zfill(3) for county, fips in CONFIG["census"]["counties"].items()}
hhsize_6p_multiplier = float(CONFIG["non_gq"]["hhsize_6p_multiplier"])

maz_shape_path = INPUT_DIR / CONFIG["geography"]["maz_shape"]
block_group_shapefile_path = INPUT_DIR / CONFIG["geography"]["block_group_shape"]
housing_units_path = INPUT_DIR / CONFIG["geography"]["housing_units_shape"]

api_key_path = Path(CONFIG["census"]["api_key_file"])
if not api_key_path.is_absolute():
    api_key_path = CONFIG_PATH.parent / api_key_path
API_KEY = environ.get("CENSUS_API_KEY") or api_key_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()

print(f"RUN_DATE: {RUN_DATE}")
print(f"Output directory: {OUTPUT_DIR}")
print(f"Target counties: {county_fips_dict}")

    1.0) Build ACS 5-year block group age controls for PopulationSim¶

    Derives demographic or household controls from ACS, Census, parcel, or model geography inputs and writes auditable CSV outputs.

    In [2]:
    Copied! 
    # 1.0) Build ACS 5-year block group age controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

age_control_columns = {
    "AGE0004": ["B01001_003E", "B01001_027E"],
    "AGE0517": ["B01001_004E", "B01001_005E", "B01001_006E", "B01001_028E", "B01001_029E", "B01001_030E"],
    "AGE1819": ["B01001_007E", "B01001_031E"],
    "AGE2024": ["B01001_008E", "B01001_009E", "B01001_010E", "B01001_032E", "B01001_033E", "B01001_034E"],
    "AGE2534": ["B01001_011E", "B01001_012E", "B01001_035E", "B01001_036E"],
    "AGE3554": ["B01001_013E", "B01001_014E", "B01001_015E", "B01001_016E", "B01001_037E", "B01001_038E", "B01001_039E", "B01001_040E"],
    "AGE5564": ["B01001_017E", "B01001_018E", "B01001_019E", "B01001_041E", "B01001_042E", "B01001_043E"],
    "AGE65P": ["B01001_020E", "B01001_021E", "B01001_022E", "B01001_023E", "B01001_024E", "B01001_025E", "B01001_044E", "B01001_045E", "B01001_046E", "B01001_047E", "B01001_048E", "B01001_049E"],
}
age_columns = list(age_control_columns.keys())
b01001_variables = sorted({variable for variables in age_control_columns.values() for variable in variables})
api_fields = ["NAME", "B01001_001E"] + b01001_variables

block_group_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_AgeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_AgeControlsBG_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_block_group_age_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "block group:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)} tract:*",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS age data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS age control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS age control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_block_group_age_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B01001 block group age controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_age = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = ["B01001_001E"] + b01001_variables
acs_age[numeric_columns] = acs_age[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_age["state"] = acs_age["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_age["county"] = acs_age["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_age["tract"] = acs_age["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_age["block group"] = acs_age["block group"].astype(str).str.zfill(1)
acs_age["BlockGroup"] = acs_age["state"] + acs_age["county"] + acs_age["tract"] + acs_age["block group"]

for age_column, source_columns in age_control_columns.items():
    acs_age[age_column] = acs_age[source_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)

acs_age["POPBASE"] = acs_age[age_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_age["B01001_TOTAL"] = acs_age["B01001_001E"].astype(int)
acs_age["AGE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_age["POPBASE"] - acs_age["B01001_TOTAL"]

block_group_controls = acs_age[["BlockGroup", *age_columns, "POPBASE"]].sort_values("BlockGroup")
validation = acs_age[["BlockGroup", "NAME", "B01001_TOTAL", "POPBASE", "AGE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

block_group_controls.to_csv(block_group_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["AGE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved block group age controls: {block_group_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Block groups: {len(block_group_controls):,}")
print(f"Block group POPBASE total: {block_group_controls['POPBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} block group(s) have age totals that do not match B01001_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

block_group_controls.head()

    1.1) Review age-control distributions by county¶

    Produces summary checks that make the generated controls or seed records easier to audit before they are used in PopulationSim.

    In [3]:
    Copied! 
    # 1.1) Review age-control distributions by county
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.
file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
age_controls_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_AgeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
review_output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "AgeControlsBG_review"
county_summary_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_AgeControlsBG_county_summary_{file_date}.csv"
county_chart_paths = []

review_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

if not age_controls_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Age controls file not found: {age_controls_path}")

age_columns = ["AGE0004", "AGE0517", "AGE1819", "AGE2024", "AGE2534", "AGE3554", "AGE5564", "AGE65P"]
required_columns = {"BlockGroup", "POPBASE", *age_columns}

age_controls = pd.read_csv(age_controls_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
missing_columns = sorted(required_columns - set(age_controls.columns))
if missing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Age controls file is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")

county_lookup = {str(fips).zfill(3): county_name for county_name, fips in county_fips_dict.items()}
age_controls["BlockGroup"] = age_controls["BlockGroup"].astype(str).str.zfill(12)
age_controls["county_fips"] = age_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]
age_controls["county_name"] = age_controls["county_fips"].map(county_lookup).fillna("Unknown")

age_controls[age_columns + ["POPBASE"]] = age_controls[age_columns + ["POPBASE"]].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce",
).fillna(0)

county_summary = (
    age_controls.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[age_columns + ["POPBASE"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("county_fips")
)

county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

for _, county_row in county_summary.iterrows():
    county_name = county_row["county_name"]
    county_fips = county_row["county_fips"]
    values = county_row[age_columns].astype(int)
    chart_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_AgeControlsBG_{county_fips}_{county_name.replace(' ', '')}_{file_date}.png"

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
    bars = ax.bar(age_columns, values, color="#4C78A8", width=0.72)
    ax.set_title(f"{county_name} County ACS {acs_year} 5-Year Age Controls")
    ax.set_xlabel("Age Group")
    ax.set_ylabel("Population")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=35)
    ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value:,.0f}" for value in values], padding=3, fontsize=9)
    ax.margins(y=0.15)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(chart_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    county_chart_paths.append(chart_path)

print(f"Saved county age summary: {county_summary_path}")
print("Saved county age charts:")
for chart_path in county_chart_paths:
    print(f"  {chart_path}")

    # 2.0) Build ACS 5-year block group sex controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

sex_control_columns = {
    "MALE": "B01001_002E",
    "FEMALE": "B01001_026E",
}
sex_columns = list(sex_control_columns.keys())
api_fields = ["NAME", "B01001_001E", *sex_control_columns.values()]

block_group_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_block_group_sex_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "block group:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)} tract:*",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS sex data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS sex control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS sex control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_block_group_sex_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B01001 block group sex controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_sex = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = ["B01001_001E", *sex_control_columns.values()]
acs_sex[numeric_columns] = acs_sex[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_sex["state"] = acs_sex["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_sex["county"] = acs_sex["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_sex["tract"] = acs_sex["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_sex["block group"] = acs_sex["block group"].astype(str).str.zfill(1)
acs_sex["BlockGroup"] = acs_sex["state"] + acs_sex["county"] + acs_sex["tract"] + acs_sex["block group"]

for output_column, source_column in sex_control_columns.items():
    acs_sex[output_column] = acs_sex[source_column].astype(int)

acs_sex["POPBASE"] = acs_sex[sex_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_sex["B01001_TOTAL"] = acs_sex["B01001_001E"].astype(int)
acs_sex["SEX_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_sex["POPBASE"] - acs_sex["B01001_TOTAL"]

block_group_controls = acs_sex[["BlockGroup", *sex_columns, "POPBASE"]].sort_values("BlockGroup")
validation = acs_sex[["BlockGroup", "NAME", "B01001_TOTAL", "POPBASE", "SEX_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

block_group_controls.to_csv(block_group_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["SEX_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved block group sex controls: {block_group_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Block groups: {len(block_group_controls):,}")
print(f"Block group POPBASE total: {block_group_controls['POPBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} block group(s) have sex totals that do not match B01001_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

block_group_controls.head()

    # 2.1) Review sex-control distributions by county
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
sex_controls_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
review_output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "SexControlsBG_review"
county_summary_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_county_summary_{file_date}.csv"
county_chart_paths = []

review_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

if not sex_controls_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Sex controls file not found: {sex_controls_path}")

sex_columns = ["MALE", "FEMALE"]
required_columns = {"BlockGroup", "POPBASE", *sex_columns}

sex_controls = pd.read_csv(sex_controls_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
missing_columns = sorted(required_columns - set(sex_controls.columns))
if missing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Sex controls file is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")

county_lookup = {str(fips).zfill(3): county_name for county_name, fips in county_fips_dict.items()}
sex_controls["BlockGroup"] = sex_controls["BlockGroup"].astype(str).str.zfill(12)
sex_controls["county_fips"] = sex_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]
sex_controls["county_name"] = sex_controls["county_fips"].map(county_lookup).fillna("Unknown")
sex_controls[sex_columns + ["POPBASE"]] = sex_controls[sex_columns + ["POPBASE"]].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce",
).fillna(0)

county_summary = (
    sex_controls.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[sex_columns + ["POPBASE"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("county_fips")
)
county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

for _, county_row in county_summary.iterrows():
    county_name = county_row["county_name"]
    county_fips = county_row["county_fips"]
    values = county_row[sex_columns].astype(int)
    chart_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_{county_fips}_{county_name.replace(' ', '')}_{file_date}.png"

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
    bars = ax.bar(sex_columns, values, color=["#4C78A8", "#F58518"], width=0.55)
    ax.set_title(f"{county_name} County ACS {acs_year} 5-Year Sex Controls")
    ax.set_xlabel("Sex")
    ax.set_ylabel("Population")
    ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value:,.0f}" for value in values], padding=3, fontsize=10)
    ax.margins(y=0.18)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(chart_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    county_chart_paths.append(chart_path)

print(f"Saved county sex summary: {county_summary_path}")
print("Saved county sex charts:")
for chart_path in county_chart_paths:
    print(f"  {chart_path}")

    # 3.0) Build ACS 5-year tract occupation controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

occupation_control_columns = {
    "OCC_T": "B08124_001E",
    "OCC_1_MGMT": "B08124_002E",
    "OCC_2_SVC": "B08124_003E",
    "OCC_3_SALES": "B08124_004E",
    "OCC_4_NAT": "B08124_005E",
    "OCC_5_PROD": "B08124_006E",
    "OCC_6_MIL": "B08124_007E",
}
occupation_columns = [column for column in occupation_control_columns if column != "OCC_T"]
b08124_variables = list(occupation_control_columns.values())
api_fields = ["NAME"] + b08124_variables

tract_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_tract_occupation_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "tract:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)}",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS occupation data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS 5-year tract occupation control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS 5-year tract occupation control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_tract_occupation_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B08124 tract occupation controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_occupation = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = b08124_variables
acs_occupation[numeric_columns] = acs_occupation[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_occupation["state"] = acs_occupation["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_occupation["county"] = acs_occupation["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_occupation["tract"] = acs_occupation["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_occupation["TRACT"] = acs_occupation["state"] + acs_occupation["county"] + acs_occupation["tract"]

for occupation_column, source_column in occupation_control_columns.items():
    acs_occupation[occupation_column] = acs_occupation[source_column].astype(int)

acs_occupation["OCC_SUM"] = acs_occupation[occupation_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_occupation["OCCUPATION_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_occupation["OCC_SUM"] - acs_occupation["OCC_T"]

tract_controls = acs_occupation[["TRACT", "OCC_T", *occupation_columns]].sort_values("TRACT")
validation = acs_occupation[["TRACT", "NAME", "OCC_T", "OCC_SUM", "OCCUPATION_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

tract_controls.to_csv(tract_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["OCCUPATION_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved tract occupation controls: {tract_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Tracts: {len(tract_controls):,}")
print(f"Tract OCC_T total: {tract_controls['OCC_T'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} tract(s) have occupation categories that do not sum to OCC_T. Review {validation_output_path}.")

    3.1) Review occupation-control distributions by county¶

    Produces summary checks that make the generated controls or seed records easier to audit before they are used in PopulationSim.

    In [7]:
    Copied! 
    # 3.1) Review occupation-control distributions by county
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
occupation_controls_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_{file_date}.csv"
review_output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "OccupationControlsTract_review"
county_summary_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_county_summary_{file_date}.csv"
county_chart_paths = []

review_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

if not occupation_controls_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Occupation controls file not found: {occupation_controls_path}")

occupation_columns = [
    "OCC_1_MGMT",
    "OCC_2_SVC",
    "OCC_3_SALES",
    "OCC_4_NAT",
    "OCC_5_PROD",
    "OCC_6_MIL",
]
required_columns = {"TRACT", "OCC_T", *occupation_columns}

occupation_controls = pd.read_csv(occupation_controls_path, dtype={"TRACT": "string"})
missing_columns = sorted(required_columns - set(occupation_controls.columns))
if missing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Occupation controls file is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")

county_lookup = {str(fips).zfill(3): county_name for county_name, fips in county_fips_dict.items()}
occupation_controls["TRACT"] = occupation_controls["TRACT"].astype(str).str.zfill(11)
occupation_controls["county_fips"] = occupation_controls["TRACT"].str[2:5]
occupation_controls["county_name"] = occupation_controls["county_fips"].map(county_lookup).fillna("Unknown")
occupation_controls[occupation_columns + ["OCC_T"]] = occupation_controls[occupation_columns + ["OCC_T"]].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce",
).fillna(0)

county_summary = (
    occupation_controls.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[occupation_columns + ["OCC_T"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("county_fips")
)
county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

plot_labels = {
    "OCC_1_MGMT": "Mgmt/Bus/Sci/Arts",
    "OCC_2_SVC": "Service",
    "OCC_3_SALES": "Sales/Office",
    "OCC_4_NAT": "Nat Res/Const/Maint",
    "OCC_5_PROD": "Prod/Trans/Move",
    "OCC_6_MIL": "Military",
}
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

for _, county_row in county_summary.iterrows():
    county_name = county_row["county_name"]
    county_fips = county_row["county_fips"]
    values = county_row[occupation_columns].astype(int)
    chart_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_{county_fips}_{county_name.replace(' ', '')}_{file_date}.png"

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 5.75))
    bars = ax.bar([plot_labels[column] for column in occupation_columns], values, color="#54A24B", width=0.68)
    ax.set_title(f"{county_name} County ACS {acs_year} 5-Year Occupation Controls")
    ax.set_xlabel("Occupation Group")
    ax.set_ylabel("Workers Age 16+")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=25)
    ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value:,.0f}" for value in values], padding=3, fontsize=9)
    ax.margins(y=0.18)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(chart_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    county_chart_paths.append(chart_path)

print(f"Saved county occupation summary: {county_summary_path}")
print("Saved county occupation charts:")
for chart_path in county_chart_paths:
    print(f"  {chart_path}")

county_summary

    4.0) Build ACS 5-year tract household-worker controls for PopulationSim¶

    Derives demographic or household controls from ACS, Census, parcel, or model geography inputs and writes auditable CSV outputs.

    In [8]:
    Copied! 
    # 4.0) Build ACS 5-year tract household-worker controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

worker_control_columns = {
    "HHWORKER0": "B08202_002E",
    "HHWORKER1": "B08202_003E",
    "HHWORKER2": "B08202_004E",
    "HHWORKER3P": "B08202_005E",
}
worker_columns = list(worker_control_columns.keys())
b08202_variables = ["B08202_001E", *worker_control_columns.values()]
api_fields = ["NAME"] + b08202_variables

tract_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdWorkerControlsTract_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdWorkerControlsTract_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_tract_household_worker_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "tract:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)}",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS household-worker data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS 5-year tract household-worker control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS 5-year tract household-worker control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_tract_household_worker_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B08202 tract household-worker controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_workers = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = b08202_variables
acs_workers[numeric_columns] = acs_workers[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_workers["state"] = acs_workers["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_workers["county"] = acs_workers["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_workers["tract"] = acs_workers["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_workers["TRACT"] = acs_workers["state"] + acs_workers["county"] + acs_workers["tract"]

for worker_column, source_column in worker_control_columns.items():
    acs_workers[worker_column] = acs_workers[source_column].astype(int)

acs_workers["HHBASE"] = acs_workers[worker_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_workers["B08202_TOTAL"] = acs_workers["B08202_001E"].astype(int)
acs_workers["HOUSEHOLD_WORKER_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_workers["HHBASE"] - acs_workers["B08202_TOTAL"]

tract_controls = acs_workers[["TRACT", *worker_columns, "HHBASE"]].sort_values("TRACT")
validation = acs_workers[["TRACT", "NAME", "B08202_TOTAL", "HHBASE", "HOUSEHOLD_WORKER_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

tract_controls.to_csv(tract_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["HOUSEHOLD_WORKER_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved tract household-worker controls: {tract_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Tracts: {len(tract_controls):,}")
print(f"Tract HHBASE total: {tract_controls['HHBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} tract(s) have household-worker categories that do not sum to B08202_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

tract_controls.head()

    # 4.1) Review household-worker control distributions by county
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
worker_controls_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdWorkerControlsTract_{file_date}.csv"
review_output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "HouseholdWorkerControlsTract_review"
county_summary_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdWorkerControlsTract_county_summary_{file_date}.csv"
county_chart_paths = []

review_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

if not worker_controls_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Household-worker controls file not found: {worker_controls_path}")

worker_columns = ["HHWORKER0", "HHWORKER1", "HHWORKER2", "HHWORKER3P"]
required_columns = {"TRACT", "HHBASE", *worker_columns}

worker_controls = pd.read_csv(worker_controls_path, dtype={"TRACT": "string"})
missing_columns = sorted(required_columns - set(worker_controls.columns))
if missing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Household-worker controls file is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")

county_lookup = {str(fips).zfill(3): county_name for county_name, fips in county_fips_dict.items()}
worker_controls["TRACT"] = worker_controls["TRACT"].astype(str).str.zfill(11)
worker_controls["county_fips"] = worker_controls["TRACT"].str[2:5]
worker_controls["county_name"] = worker_controls["county_fips"].map(county_lookup).fillna("Unknown")
worker_controls[worker_columns + ["HHBASE"]] = worker_controls[worker_columns + ["HHBASE"]].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce",
).fillna(0)

county_summary = (
    worker_controls.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[worker_columns + ["HHBASE"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("county_fips")
)
county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

plot_labels = {
    "HHWORKER0": "0 workers",
    "HHWORKER1": "1 worker",
    "HHWORKER2": "2 workers",
    "HHWORKER3P": "3+ workers",
}
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

for _, county_row in county_summary.iterrows():
    county_name = county_row["county_name"]
    county_fips = county_row["county_fips"]
    values = county_row[worker_columns].astype(int)
    chart_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdWorkerControlsTract_{county_fips}_{county_name.replace(' ', '')}_{file_date}.png"

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
    bars = ax.bar([plot_labels[column] for column in worker_columns], values, color="#E45756", width=0.62)
    ax.set_title(f"{county_name} County ACS {acs_year} 5-Year Household-Worker Controls")
    ax.set_xlabel("Workers in Household")
    ax.set_ylabel("Households")
    ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value:,.0f}" for value in values], padding=3, fontsize=9)
    ax.margins(y=0.18)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(chart_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    county_chart_paths.append(chart_path)

print(f"Saved county household-worker summary: {county_summary_path}")
print("Saved county household-worker charts:")
for chart_path in county_chart_paths:
    print(f"  {chart_path}")

    5.0) Build ACS 5-year block group household child-presence controls for PopulationSim¶

    Derives demographic or household controls from ACS, Census, parcel, or model geography inputs and writes auditable CSV outputs.

    In [10]:
    Copied! 
    # 5.0) Build ACS 5-year block group household child-presence controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

child_control_columns = {
    "HHCHILD": "B11005_002E",
    "HHNOCHILD": "B11005_011E",
}
child_columns = list(child_control_columns.keys())
b11005_variables = ["B11005_001E", *child_control_columns.values()]
api_fields = ["NAME"] + b11005_variables

block_group_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_ChildPresenceControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_ChildPresenceControlsBG_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_block_group_child_presence_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "block group:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)} tract:*",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS child-presence data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS 5-year block group child-presence control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS 5-year block group child-presence control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_block_group_child_presence_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B11005 block group child-presence controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_child = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = b11005_variables
acs_child[numeric_columns] = acs_child[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_child["state"] = acs_child["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_child["county"] = acs_child["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_child["tract"] = acs_child["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_child["block group"] = acs_child["block group"].astype(str).str.zfill(1)
acs_child["BlockGroup"] = acs_child["state"] + acs_child["county"] + acs_child["tract"] + acs_child["block group"]

for child_column, source_column in child_control_columns.items():
    acs_child[child_column] = acs_child[source_column].astype(int)

acs_child["HHBASE"] = acs_child[child_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_child["B11005_TOTAL"] = acs_child["B11005_001E"].astype(int)
acs_child["CHILD_PRESENCE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_child["HHBASE"] - acs_child["B11005_TOTAL"]

block_group_controls = acs_child[["BlockGroup", *child_columns, "HHBASE"]].sort_values("BlockGroup")
validation = acs_child[["BlockGroup", "NAME", "B11005_TOTAL", "HHBASE", "CHILD_PRESENCE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

block_group_controls.to_csv(block_group_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["CHILD_PRESENCE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved block group child-presence controls: {block_group_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Block groups: {len(block_group_controls):,}")
print(f"Block group HHBASE total: {block_group_controls['HHBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} block group(s) have child-presence categories that do not sum to B11005_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

block_group_controls.head()

    # 6.0) Build ACS 5-year block group household-size controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

household_size_control_columns = {
    "HHSIZE1": ["B11016_010E"],
    "HHSIZE2": ["B11016_003E", "B11016_011E"],
    "HHSIZE3": ["B11016_004E", "B11016_012E"],
    "HHSIZE4": ["B11016_005E", "B11016_013E"],
    "HHSIZE5": ["B11016_006E", "B11016_014E"],
    "HHSIZE6P": ["B11016_007E", "B11016_008E", "B11016_015E", "B11016_016E"],
}
household_size_columns = list(household_size_control_columns.keys())
b11016_variables = ["B11016_001E"] + sorted({var for vars_ in household_size_control_columns.values() for var in vars_})
api_fields = ["NAME"] + b11016_variables

block_group_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdSizeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdSizeControlsBG_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_block_group_household_size_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "block group:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)} tract:*",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS household-size data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS 5-year block group household-size control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS 5-year block group household-size control request failed for {county_name} County.")



# Clean household-size distributions before writing the BG control file.
def fill_missing_hhsize_controls(df, size_cols, geoid_col="BlockGroup"):
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean[size_cols] = df_clean[size_cols].fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_clean["GEOID_str"] = df_clean[geoid_col].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)
    df_clean["Tract"] = df_clean["GEOID_str"].str[:11]
    df_clean["County"] = df_clean["GEOID_str"].str[:5]
    df_clean["Total_HH"] = df_clean[size_cols].sum(axis=1)

    empty_mask = df_clean["Total_HH"].eq(0)
    if not empty_mask.any():
        return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "County", "Total_HH"])

    print(f"Found {int(empty_mask.sum()):,} block group(s) with 0 household-size controls. Cascading tract/county/region seeds.")
    tract_totals = df_clean.groupby("Tract")[size_cols].sum()
    county_totals = df_clean.groupby("County")[size_cols].sum()
    regional_totals = df_clean[size_cols].sum()

    for index, row in df_clean[empty_mask].iterrows():
        tract_id = row["Tract"]
        county_id = row["County"]
        if tract_id in tract_totals.index and tract_totals.loc[tract_id].sum() > 0:
            df_clean.loc[index, size_cols] = tract_totals.loc[tract_id].values
        elif county_id in county_totals.index and county_totals.loc[county_id].sum() > 0:
            print(f"Tract {tract_id} is empty. Seeding BG {row[geoid_col]} with county {county_id} distribution.")
            df_clean.loc[index, size_cols] = county_totals.loc[county_id].values
        else:
            print(f"County {county_id} is empty. Seeding BG {row[geoid_col]} with regional distribution.")
            df_clean.loc[index, size_cols] = regional_totals.values

    return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "County", "Total_HH"])


def smooth_hhsize_donut_holes(df, size_cols, geoid_col="BlockGroup"):
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean[size_cols] = df_clean[size_cols].fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_clean["GEOID_str"] = df_clean[geoid_col].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)
    df_clean["Tract"] = df_clean["GEOID_str"].str[:11]
    df_clean["Total_HH"] = df_clean[size_cols].sum(axis=1)

    col_1, col_2, col_3, col_4, col_5, col_6p = size_cols
    sum_below_2 = df_clean[col_1]
    sum_below_3 = sum_below_2 + df_clean[col_2]
    sum_below_4 = sum_below_3 + df_clean[col_3]
    sum_below_5 = sum_below_4 + df_clean[col_4]
    sum_above_5 = df_clean[col_6p]
    sum_above_4 = sum_above_5 + df_clean[col_5]
    sum_above_3 = sum_above_4 + df_clean[col_4]
    sum_above_2 = sum_above_3 + df_clean[col_3]

    pct_threshold = 0.08
    min_households = 40
    dynamic_threshold = np.maximum(min_households, df_clean["Total_HH"] * pct_threshold)
    donut_2 = df_clean[col_2].eq(0) & sum_below_2.ge(dynamic_threshold) & sum_above_2.ge(dynamic_threshold)
    donut_3 = df_clean[col_3].eq(0) & sum_below_3.ge(dynamic_threshold) & sum_above_3.ge(dynamic_threshold)
    donut_4 = df_clean[col_4].eq(0) & sum_below_4.ge(dynamic_threshold) & sum_above_4.ge(dynamic_threshold)
    donut_5 = df_clean[col_5].eq(0) & sum_below_5.ge(dynamic_threshold) & sum_above_5.ge(dynamic_threshold)
    broken_mask = donut_2 | donut_3 | donut_4 | donut_5

    if not broken_mask.any():
        return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "Total_HH"])

    print(f"Found {int(broken_mask.sum()):,} block group(s) with household-size donut holes. Applying tract smoothing.")
    tract_totals = df_clean.groupby("Tract")[size_cols].sum()
    tract_dist = tract_totals.div(tract_totals.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)

    for index, row in df_clean[broken_mask].iterrows():
        tract_id = row["Tract"]
        total_hhs = int(row["Total_HH"])
        if total_hhs <= 0 or tract_id not in tract_dist.index or tract_totals.loc[tract_id].sum() <= 0:
            continue
        exact_values = total_hhs * tract_dist.loc[tract_id]
        smoothed_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
        diff = total_hhs - int(smoothed_values.sum())
        if diff > 0:
            remainders = exact_values - smoothed_values
            smoothed_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
        elif diff < 0:
            subtract_index = smoothed_values[smoothed_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
            smoothed_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1
        df_clean.loc[index, size_cols] = smoothed_values.values

    return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "Total_HH"])


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_block_group_household_size_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B11016 block group household-size controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_hhsize = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = b11016_variables
acs_hhsize[numeric_columns] = acs_hhsize[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_hhsize["state"] = acs_hhsize["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_hhsize["county"] = acs_hhsize["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_hhsize["tract"] = acs_hhsize["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_hhsize["block group"] = acs_hhsize["block group"].astype(str).str.zfill(1)
acs_hhsize["BlockGroup"] = acs_hhsize["state"] + acs_hhsize["county"] + acs_hhsize["tract"] + acs_hhsize["block group"]

for household_size_column, source_columns in household_size_control_columns.items():
    acs_hhsize[household_size_column] = acs_hhsize[source_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_hhsize[household_size_columns] = acs_hhsize[household_size_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
acs_hhsize = fill_missing_hhsize_controls(acs_hhsize, household_size_columns, geoid_col="BlockGroup")
acs_hhsize = smooth_hhsize_donut_holes(acs_hhsize, household_size_columns, geoid_col="BlockGroup")
 

acs_hhsize["HHBASE"] = acs_hhsize[household_size_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_hhsize["B11016_TOTAL"] = acs_hhsize["B11016_001E"].astype(int)
acs_hhsize["HOUSEHOLD_SIZE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_hhsize["HHBASE"] - acs_hhsize["B11016_TOTAL"]

block_group_controls = acs_hhsize[["BlockGroup", *household_size_columns, "HHBASE"]].sort_values("BlockGroup")
validation = acs_hhsize[["BlockGroup", "NAME", "B11016_TOTAL", "HHBASE", "HOUSEHOLD_SIZE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

block_group_controls.to_csv(block_group_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["HOUSEHOLD_SIZE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved block group household-size controls: {block_group_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Block groups: {len(block_group_controls):,}")
print(f"Block group HHBASE total: {block_group_controls['HHBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} block group(s) have household-size categories that do not sum to B11016_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

block_group_controls.head()

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
household_size_controls_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdSizeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
review_output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "HouseholdSizeControlsBG_review"

    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Household-size controls file not found: {household_size_controls_path}")

household_size_columns = ["HHSIZE1", "HHSIZE2", "HHSIZE3", "HHSIZE4", "HHSIZE5", "HHSIZE6P"]
required_columns = {"BlockGroup", "HHBASE", *household_size_columns}

household_size_controls = pd.read_csv(household_size_controls_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
missing_columns = sorted(required_columns - set(household_size_controls.columns))
if missing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Household-size controls file is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")

county_lookup = {str(fips).zfill(3): county_name for county_name, fips in county_fips_dict.items()}
household_size_controls["BlockGroup"] = household_size_controls["BlockGroup"].astype(str).str.zfill(12)
household_size_controls["county_fips"] = household_size_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]
household_size_controls["county_name"] = household_size_controls["county_fips"].map(county_lookup).fillna("Unknown")
household_size_controls[household_size_columns + ["HHBASE"]] = household_size_controls[household_size_columns + ["HHBASE"]].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce",
).fillna(0)

county_summary = (
    household_size_controls.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[household_size_columns + ["HHBASE"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("county_fips")
)
county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

plot_labels = {
    "HHSIZE1": "1 person",
    "HHSIZE2": "2 persons",
    "HHSIZE3": "3 persons",
    "HHSIZE4": "4 persons",
    "HHSIZE5": "5 persons",
    "HHSIZE6P": "6+ persons",
}
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

for _, county_row in county_summary.iterrows():
    county_name = county_row["county_name"]
    county_fips = county_row["county_fips"]
    values = county_row[household_size_columns].astype(int)
    chart_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdSizeControlsBG_{county_fips}_{county_name.replace(' ', '')}_{file_date}.png"

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 5.75))
    bars = ax.bar([plot_labels[column] for column in household_size_columns], values, color="#F58518", width=0.68)
    ax.set_title(f"{county_name} County ACS {acs_year} 5-Year Household-Size Controls")
    ax.set_xlabel("Household Size")
    ax.set_ylabel("Households")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=25)
    ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value:,.0f}" for value in values], padding=3, fontsize=9)
    ax.margins(y=0.18)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(chart_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    county_chart_paths.append(chart_path)

print(f"Saved county household-size summary: {county_summary_path}")
print("Saved county household-size charts:")
for chart_path in county_chart_paths:
    print(f"  {chart_path}")

    # 7.0) Build ACS 5-year block group household-income controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

income_control_columns = {
    "HHINC000_025": ["B19001_002E", "B19001_003E", "B19001_004E", "B19001_005E"],
    "HHINC025_050": ["B19001_006E", "B19001_007E", "B19001_008E", "B19001_009E", "B19001_010E"],
    "HHINC050_075": ["B19001_011E", "B19001_012E"],
    "HHINC075_100": ["B19001_013E"],
    "HHINC100_125": ["B19001_014E"],
    "HHINC125_150": ["B19001_015E"],
    "HHINC150_200": ["B19001_016E"],
    "HHINC200P": ["B19001_017E"],
}
income_columns = list(income_control_columns.keys())
b19001_variables = ["B19001_001E"] + sorted({var for vars_ in income_control_columns.values() for var in vars_})
api_fields = ["NAME"] + b19001_variables

block_group_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_IncomeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_IncomeControlsBG_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_block_group_income_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "block group:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)} tract:*",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS income data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS 5-year block group income control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS 5-year block group income control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_block_group_income_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B19001 block group household-income controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_income = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = b19001_variables
acs_income[numeric_columns] = acs_income[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_income["state"] = acs_income["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_income["county"] = acs_income["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_income["tract"] = acs_income["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_income["block group"] = acs_income["block group"].astype(str).str.zfill(1)
acs_income["BlockGroup"] = acs_income["state"] + acs_income["county"] + acs_income["tract"] + acs_income["block group"]

for income_column, source_columns in income_control_columns.items():
    acs_income[income_column] = acs_income[source_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)

acs_income["HHBASE"] = acs_income[income_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_income["B19001_TOTAL"] = acs_income["B19001_001E"].astype(int)
acs_income["INCOME_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_income["HHBASE"] - acs_income["B19001_TOTAL"]

block_group_controls = acs_income[["BlockGroup", *income_columns, "HHBASE"]].sort_values("BlockGroup")
validation = acs_income[["BlockGroup", "NAME", "B19001_TOTAL", "HHBASE", "INCOME_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

block_group_controls.to_csv(block_group_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["INCOME_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved block group household-income controls: {block_group_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Block groups: {len(block_group_controls):,}")
print(f"Block group HHBASE total: {block_group_controls['HHBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} block group(s) have income categories that do not sum to B19001_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

block_group_controls.head()

    Derives demographic or household controls from ACS, Census, parcel, or model geography inputs and writes auditable CSV outputs.

    # 8.0) Build ACS 5-year block group household-type controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

household_type_control_columns = {
    "HHTYPE_FAMILY": "B11001_002E",
    "HHTYPE_NONFAMILY": "B11001_007E",
}
household_type_columns = list(household_type_control_columns.keys())
acs_variables = ["B11001_001E", *household_type_control_columns.values()]
api_fields = ["NAME"] + acs_variables

block_group_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdTypeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdTypeControlsBG_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_block_group_household_type_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "block group:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)} tract:*",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS household-type data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS 5-year block group household-type control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS 5-year block group household-type control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_block_group_household_type_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B11001 block group household-type controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_hht = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = acs_variables
acs_hht[numeric_columns] = acs_hht[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_hht["state"] = acs_hht["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_hht["county"] = acs_hht["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_hht["tract"] = acs_hht["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_hht["block group"] = acs_hht["block group"].astype(str).str.zfill(1)
acs_hht["BlockGroup"] = acs_hht["state"] + acs_hht["county"] + acs_hht["tract"] + acs_hht["block group"]

for household_type_column, source_column in household_type_control_columns.items():
    acs_hht[household_type_column] = acs_hht[source_column].astype(int)

acs_hht["HHBASE"] = acs_hht[household_type_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_hht["B11001_TOTAL"] = acs_hht["B11001_001E"].astype(int)
acs_hht["HOUSEHOLD_TYPE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_hht["HHBASE"] - acs_hht["B11001_TOTAL"]

block_group_controls = acs_hht[["BlockGroup", *household_type_columns, "HHBASE"]].sort_values("BlockGroup")
validation = acs_hht[["BlockGroup", "NAME", "B11001_TOTAL", "HHBASE", "HOUSEHOLD_TYPE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

block_group_controls.to_csv(block_group_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["HOUSEHOLD_TYPE_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved block group household-type controls: {block_group_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Block groups: {len(block_group_controls):,}")
print(f"Block group HHBASE total: {block_group_controls['HHBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} block group(s) have household-type categories that do not sum to B11001_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

block_group_controls.head()

    # 8.1) Review household-type control distributions by county
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
household_type_controls_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdTypeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
review_output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "HouseholdTypeControlsBG_review"
county_summary_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdTypeControlsBG_county_summary_{file_date}.csv"
county_chart_paths = []

review_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

if not household_type_controls_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Household-type controls file not found: {household_type_controls_path}")

household_type_columns = ["HHTYPE_FAMILY", "HHTYPE_NONFAMILY"]
required_columns = {"BlockGroup", "HHBASE", *household_type_columns}

household_type_controls = pd.read_csv(household_type_controls_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
missing_columns = sorted(required_columns - set(household_type_controls.columns))
if missing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Household-type controls file is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")

county_lookup = {str(fips).zfill(3): county_name for county_name, fips in county_fips_dict.items()}
household_type_controls["BlockGroup"] = household_type_controls["BlockGroup"].astype(str).str.zfill(12)
household_type_controls["county_fips"] = household_type_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]
household_type_controls["county_name"] = household_type_controls["county_fips"].map(county_lookup).fillna("Unknown")
household_type_controls[household_type_columns + ["HHBASE"]] = household_type_controls[household_type_columns + ["HHBASE"]].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce",
).fillna(0)

county_summary = (
    household_type_controls.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[household_type_columns + ["HHBASE"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("county_fips")
)
county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

plot_labels = {
    "HHTYPE_FAMILY": "Family households",
    "HHTYPE_NONFAMILY": "Nonfamily households",
}
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

for _, county_row in county_summary.iterrows():
    county_name = county_row["county_name"]
    county_fips = county_row["county_fips"]
    values = county_row[household_type_columns].astype(int)
    chart_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdTypeControlsBG_{county_fips}_{county_name.replace(' ', '')}_{file_date}.png"

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.5))
    bars = ax.bar([plot_labels[column] for column in household_type_columns], values, color=["#4C78A8", "#F58518"], width=0.58)
    ax.set_title(f"{county_name} County ACS {acs_year} 5-Year Household-Type Controls")
    ax.set_xlabel("Household Type")
    ax.set_ylabel("Households")
    ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value:,.0f}" for value in values], padding=3, fontsize=10)
    ax.margins(y=0.18)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(chart_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    county_chart_paths.append(chart_path)

print(f"Saved county household-type summary: {county_summary_path}")
print("Saved county household-type charts:")
for chart_path in county_chart_paths:
    print(f"  {chart_path}")

    9.0) Build MAZ-level single-family and multifamily housing-unit controls¶

    Derives demographic or household controls from ACS, Census, parcel, or model geography inputs and writes auditable CSV outputs.

    In [18]:

    # 9.0) Build MAZ-level single-family and multifamily housing-unit controls
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_SF_MF_HousingInventory_{file_date}.csv"
county_summary_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_SF_MF_HousingInventory_county_summary_{file_date}.csv"
unmatched_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_SF_MF_HousingInventory_unmatched_points_{file_date}.csv"

required_paths = {
    "MAZ shapefile": maz_shape_path,
    "Housing-unit centroid shapefile": housing_units_path,
}
missing_paths = [f"{name}: {path}" for name, path in required_paths.items() if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required input file(s) not found: {missing_paths}")

maz = gpd.read_file(maz_shape_path)
housing_units = gpd.read_file(housing_units_path)

required_maz_columns = {"maz_id", "CO_NAME", "geometry"}
required_housing_columns = {"APX_BLT_YR", "UNIT_COUNT", "BTYPE", "geometry"}
missing_maz_columns = sorted(required_maz_columns - set(maz.columns))
missing_housing_columns = sorted(required_housing_columns - set(housing_units.columns))
if missing_maz_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"MAZ shapefile is missing required column(s): {missing_maz_columns}")
if missing_housing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Housing-unit file is missing required column(s): {missing_housing_columns}")

maz = maz[["maz_id", "CO_NAME", "geometry"]].copy()
maz["maz_id"] = pd.to_numeric(maz["maz_id"], errors="coerce")
maz = maz.dropna(subset=["maz_id"]).copy()
maz["maz_id"] = maz["maz_id"].astype(int)
maz = maz.drop_duplicates(subset=["maz_id"])

housing_units = housing_units.to_crs(maz.crs)
housing_units = housing_units.dropna(subset=["geometry"]).copy()
housing_units = housing_units[~housing_units.geometry.is_empty].copy()
housing_units["APX_BLT_YR"] = pd.to_numeric(housing_units["APX_BLT_YR"], errors="coerce")
housing_units["UNIT_COUNT"] = pd.to_numeric(housing_units["UNIT_COUNT"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
housing_units["BTYPE"] = pd.to_numeric(housing_units["BTYPE"], errors="coerce")

housing_units = housing_units[
    housing_units["APX_BLT_YR"].le(int(YEAR))
    & housing_units["UNIT_COUNT"].gt(0)
].copy()
housing_units["building_type"] = np.where(housing_units["BTYPE"].eq(1), "SF", "MF")

matched_units = gpd.sjoin(
    housing_units[["APX_BLT_YR", "UNIT_COUNT", "BTYPE", "building_type", "geometry"]],
    maz[["maz_id", "CO_NAME", "geometry"]],
    how="left",
    predicate="within",
).drop(columns=["index_right"], errors="ignore")

unmatched_units = matched_units[matched_units["maz_id"].isna()].copy()
if not unmatched_units.empty:
    unmatched_units.drop(columns="geometry", errors="ignore").to_csv(unmatched_output_path, index=False)

matched_units = matched_units.dropna(subset=["maz_id"]).copy()
matched_units["maz_id"] = matched_units["maz_id"].astype(int)

maz_housing = (
    matched_units.groupby(["maz_id", "building_type"], as_index=False)["UNIT_COUNT"]
    .sum()
    .pivot(index="maz_id", columns="building_type", values="UNIT_COUNT")
    .fillna(0)
    .reset_index()
)

for column in ["SF", "MF"]:
    if column not in maz_housing.columns:
        maz_housing[column] = 0

maz_housing = maz[["maz_id", "CO_NAME"]].merge(
    maz_housing[["maz_id", "SF", "MF"]],
    on="maz_id",
    how="left",
)
maz_housing[["SF", "MF"]] = maz_housing[["SF", "MF"]].fillna(0).round().astype(int)
maz_housing["TOTAL_HU"] = maz_housing["SF"] + maz_housing["MF"]
maz_housing = maz_housing[["maz_id", "CO_NAME", "SF", "MF", "TOTAL_HU"]].sort_values("maz_id")

county_summary = (
    maz_housing.groupby("CO_NAME", as_index=False)[["SF", "MF", "TOTAL_HU"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("CO_NAME")
)

source_unit_total = int(housing_units["UNIT_COUNT"].sum())
matched_unit_total = int(matched_units["UNIT_COUNT"].sum())
unmatched_unit_total = source_unit_total - matched_unit_total

maz_housing.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved MAZ housing inventory: {output_path}")
print(f"Saved county summary: {county_summary_path}")
print(f"MAZs: {len(maz_housing):,}")
print(f"MAZs with housing units: {maz_housing['TOTAL_HU'].gt(0).sum():,}")
print(f"Source housing units: {source_unit_total:,}")
print(f"Matched housing units: {matched_unit_total:,}")
print(f"Unmatched housing units: {unmatched_unit_total:,}")
if unmatched_unit_total:
    print(f"WARNING: Unmatched housing-unit points were saved for review: {unmatched_output_path}")

    # 10.0) Build county household and population controls
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"County_Household_Population_Controls_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"County_Household_Population_Controls_validation_{file_date}.csv"

county_totals = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {"county_name": "Box Elder", "county_fips": "003", "raw_households": 11146, "raw_persons": 32375, "exclude_households": 0, "exclude_persons": 0},
        {"county_name": "Davis", "county_fips": "011", "raw_households": 122330, "raw_persons": 374974, "exclude_households": 0, "exclude_persons": 0},
        {"county_name": "Salt Lake", "county_fips": "035", "raw_households": 437303, "raw_persons": 1201970, "exclude_households": 1002, "exclude_persons": 2205},
        {"county_name": "Utah", "county_fips": "049", "raw_households": 220334, "raw_persons": 710816, "exclude_households": 383, "exclude_persons": 1224},
        {"county_name": "Weber", "county_fips": "057", "raw_households": 94016, "raw_persons": 257530, "exclude_households": 33, "exclude_persons": 63},
    ]
)

numeric_columns = ["raw_households", "raw_persons", "exclude_households", "exclude_persons"]
county_totals[numeric_columns] = county_totals[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
county_totals["county_fips"] = county_totals["county_fips"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
county_totals["COUNTY"] = state_code + county_totals["county_fips"]
county_totals["TOTHH"] = county_totals["raw_households"] - county_totals["exclude_households"]
county_totals["TOTpersons"] = county_totals["raw_persons"] - county_totals["exclude_persons"]
county_totals["avg_household_size"] = np.where(
    county_totals["TOTHH"].gt(0),
    county_totals["TOTpersons"] / county_totals["TOTHH"],
    np.nan,
)

output_columns = [
    "COUNTY",
    "county_name",
    "county_fips",
    "TOTHH",
    "TOTpersons",
    "raw_households",
    "raw_persons",
    "exclude_households",
    "exclude_persons",
    "avg_household_size",
]
county_controls = county_totals[output_columns].sort_values("COUNTY")

validation = county_controls.copy()
validation["household_control_valid"] = validation["TOTHH"].ge(0)
validation["person_control_valid"] = validation["TOTpersons"].ge(0)
validation["county_in_target_counties"] = validation["county_fips"].isin(
    {str(fips).zfill(3) for fips in county_fips_dict.values()}
)

county_controls.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved county household/population controls: {output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Counties: {len(county_controls):,}")
print(f"Total households: {county_controls['TOTHH'].sum():,}")
print(f"Total persons: {county_controls['TOTpersons'].sum():,}")

invalid_controls = validation[
    ~validation["household_control_valid"]
    | ~validation["person_control_valid"]
    | ~validation["county_in_target_counties"]
]
if not invalid_controls.empty:
    print("WARNING: Some county controls failed validation. Review the validation file.")

    # 11.0) Convert fixed vacancy rates from TAZ to MAZ
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
input_path = INPUT_ROOT / "housing_by_TDM_TAZ06112025_manualFixedVacancyrate.csv"
maz_crosswalk_path = FINAL_OUTPUT_DIR / "maz_taz_equivalency.csv"
# maz_crosswalk_path = Path("Output") / file_date / f"geo_crosswalk_maz_bg_tract_puma_{file_date}.csv"
output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"housing_by_MAZ_{file_date}_manualFixedVacancyrate.csv"
audit_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"housing_by_MAZ_{file_date}_manualFixedVacancyrate_audit.csv"
missing_taz_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"housing_by_MAZ_{file_date}_manualFixedVacancyrate_missing_taz.csv"

required_files = {
    "TAZ fixed-vacancy input": input_path,
    "MAZ geography crosswalk": maz_crosswalk_path,
}
missing_files = [f"{name}: {path}" for name, path in required_files.items() if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_files:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required input file(s) not found: {missing_files}")

fixed_vacancy = pd.read_csv(input_path)
maz_crosswalk = pd.read_csv(maz_crosswalk_path, dtype={"maz_id": "Int64", "TAZID": "Int64"})

fixed_vacancy.columns = fixed_vacancy.columns.str.strip()
maz_crosswalk.columns = maz_crosswalk.columns.str.strip()

fixed_taz_column = next((column for column in ["TAZID", "taz_id", "TAZ", "TDM_TAZ"] if column in fixed_vacancy.columns), None)
fixed_vacancy_column = next((column for column in ["fixed_vac", "fixed_vacancy", "FIXED_VAC", "vacancy_rate"] if column in fixed_vacancy.columns), None)

if fixed_taz_column is None:
    raise KeyError("TAZ fixed-vacancy input is missing a TAZ ID column. Checked: TAZID, taz_id, TAZ, TDM_TAZ.")
if fixed_vacancy_column is None:
    raise KeyError("TAZ fixed-vacancy input is missing a fixed-vacancy column. Checked: fixed_vac, fixed_vacancy, FIXED_VAC, vacancy_rate.")

required_crosswalk_columns = {"maz_id", "TAZID"}
missing_crosswalk_columns = sorted(required_crosswalk_columns - set(maz_crosswalk.columns))
if missing_crosswalk_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"MAZ geography crosswalk is missing required column(s): {missing_crosswalk_columns}")

fixed_vacancy = fixed_vacancy[[fixed_taz_column, fixed_vacancy_column]].copy()
fixed_vacancy = fixed_vacancy.rename(columns={fixed_taz_column: "TAZID", fixed_vacancy_column: "fixed_vac"})
fixed_vacancy["TAZID"] = pd.to_numeric(fixed_vacancy["TAZID"], errors="coerce")
fixed_vacancy["fixed_vac"] = pd.to_numeric(fixed_vacancy["fixed_vac"], errors="coerce")
fixed_vacancy = fixed_vacancy.dropna(subset=["TAZID", "fixed_vac"]).copy()
fixed_vacancy["TAZID"] = fixed_vacancy["TAZID"].astype(int)
fixed_vacancy = fixed_vacancy.drop_duplicates(subset=["TAZID"], keep="last")

maz_crosswalk = maz_crosswalk[["maz_id", "TAZID"]].dropna(subset=["maz_id", "TAZID"]).copy()
maz_crosswalk["maz_id"] = maz_crosswalk["maz_id"].astype(int)
maz_crosswalk["TAZID"] = maz_crosswalk["TAZID"].astype(int)
maz_crosswalk = maz_crosswalk.drop_duplicates(subset=["maz_id"])

maz_fixed_vacancy = maz_crosswalk.merge(fixed_vacancy, on="TAZID", how="left")
missing_taz = maz_fixed_vacancy[maz_fixed_vacancy["fixed_vac"].isna()].copy()
if not missing_taz.empty:
    missing_taz.to_csv(missing_taz_output_path, index=False)

output = (
    maz_fixed_vacancy.dropna(subset=["fixed_vac"])
    [["maz_id", "fixed_vac"]]
    .sort_values("maz_id")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
audit = maz_fixed_vacancy[["maz_id", "TAZID", "fixed_vac"]].sort_values("maz_id")

output.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
audit.to_csv(audit_output_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved MAZ fixed-vacancy controls: {output_path}")
print(f"Saved audit file: {audit_output_path}")
print(f"TAZ fixed-vacancy records: {len(fixed_vacancy):,}")
print(f"MAZ records in crosswalk: {len(maz_crosswalk):,}")
print(f"MAZ records with fixed vacancy: {len(output):,}")
print(f"MAZ records missing fixed vacancy: {len(missing_taz):,}")
if not missing_taz.empty:
    print(f"WARNING: MAZ records without matching TAZ fixed vacancy were saved for review: {missing_taz_output_path}")
