file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR

age_control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_AgeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
audit_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_Person_Controls_audit_{file_date}.csv"
age_regional_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bgpersons_Regional_AGE_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
age_county_filename_template = "bgpersons_{county_name}_AGE_distributed_" + f"{file_date}.csv"
age_validation_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"BG_AGE_distribution_validation_{file_date}.csv"

acs_age_columns = ["AGE0004", "AGE0517", "AGE1819", "AGE2024", "AGE2534", "AGE3554", "AGE5564", "AGE65P"]
age_output_columns = ["AGE_0_4", "AGE_5_17", "AGE_18_19", "AGE_20_24", "AGE_25_34", "AGE_35_54", "AGE_55_64", "AGE_65P"]

required_paths = [age_control_path, audit_output_path]
missing_paths = [path for path in required_paths if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run cells 1.0 and 13.0 first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def allocate_age_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="POPBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    diff = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if diff > 0:
        remainders = exact_values - integer_values
        integer_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
    elif diff < 0:
        subtract_index = integer_values[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
        integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)

age_controls = pd.read_csv(age_control_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
age_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in age_controls.columns]
missing_age_columns = sorted(set(["BlockGroup", *acs_age_columns]) - set(age_controls.columns))
if missing_age_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Age controls are missing required column(s): {missing_age_columns}")

age_controls["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(age_controls["BlockGroup"])
age_controls[acs_age_columns] = age_controls[acs_age_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
age_controls["AGE_0_4"] = age_controls["AGE0004"]
age_controls["AGE_5_17"] = age_controls["AGE0517"]
age_controls["AGE_18_19"] = age_controls["AGE1819"]
age_controls["AGE_20_24"] = age_controls["AGE2024"]
age_controls["AGE_25_34"] = age_controls["AGE2534"]
age_controls["AGE_35_54"] = age_controls["AGE3554"]
age_controls["AGE_55_64"] = age_controls["AGE5564"]
age_controls["AGE_65P"] = age_controls["AGE65P"]
age_controls["ACS_AGE_TOTAL"] = age_controls[age_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
for column in age_output_columns:
    age_controls[f"{column}_SHARE"] = np.where(
        age_controls["ACS_AGE_TOTAL"].gt(0),
        age_controls[column] / age_controls["ACS_AGE_TOTAL"],
        np.nan,
    )

if "maz" in globals() and {"maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"}.issubset(set(maz.columns)):
    maz_age = maz[["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]].copy()
else:
    maz_age = pd.read_csv(audit_output_path, dtype={"maz_id": "Int64", "BlockGroup": "string", "county_fips": "string"})[
        ["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]
    ].copy()

maz_age["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_age["BlockGroup"])
maz_age["county_fips"] = maz_age["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_age["PERSONS"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_age["PERSONS"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

bg_persons = (
    maz_age.groupby(["BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)["PERSONS"]
    .sum()
    .rename(columns={"PERSONS": "POPBASE"})
    .sort_values("BlockGroup")
)
share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in age_output_columns]
bg_age = bg_persons.merge(age_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_AGE_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="BlockGroup", how="left")

missing_age_controls = bg_age[bg_age[share_columns].isna().all(axis=1)][["BlockGroup", "POPBASE"]]
if not missing_age_controls.empty:
    county_distribution = age_controls.assign(county_fips=age_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]).groupby("county_fips")[age_output_columns].sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.div(county_distribution.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)
    regional_distribution = age_controls[age_output_columns].sum()
    regional_distribution = regional_distribution / regional_distribution.sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.rename(columns={column: f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE" for column in age_output_columns}).reset_index()
    bg_age = bg_age.merge(county_distribution, on="county_fips", how="left")
    for column in age_output_columns:
        bg_age[f"{column}_SHARE"] = bg_age[f"{column}_SHARE"].fillna(bg_age[f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_distribution[column])
    print(f"Filled age shares for {len(missing_age_controls):,} BG record(s) without BG age controls.")

for share_column in share_columns:
    bg_age[share_column] = bg_age[share_column].fillna(1 / len(share_columns))

bg_age[age_output_columns] = bg_age.apply(
    allocate_age_mix,
    axis=1,
    share_columns=share_columns,
    output_columns=age_output_columns,
)
bg_age["persons_final"] = bg_age[age_output_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
if not bg_age["persons_final"].eq(bg_age["POPBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = bg_age[~bg_age["persons_final"].eq(bg_age["POPBASE"])][["BlockGroup", "POPBASE", "persons_final"]]
    raise ValueError(f"Age allocation does not sum to POPBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

output_columns = ["BlockGroup", "persons_final", *age_output_columns]
age_validation = bg_age.merge(
    age_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_AGE_TOTAL", *age_output_columns]],
    on="BlockGroup",
    how="left",
    suffixes=("", "_ACS"),
)
age_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_AGE"] = age_validation["persons_final"] - age_validation[age_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
age_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_ACS_POPBASE"] = age_validation["persons_final"] - age_validation["ACS_AGE_TOTAL"].fillna(0)

bg_age[output_columns].to_csv(age_regional_output_path, index=False)
age_county_paths = []
for (county_fips, county_name), county_rows in bg_age.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], sort=True):
    county_path = OUTPUT_DIR / age_county_filename_template.format(county_name=county_name)
    county_rows[output_columns].to_csv(county_path, index=False)
    age_county_paths.append(county_path)
age_validation.to_csv(age_validation_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved regional BG age controls: {age_regional_output_path}")
print("Saved county BG age controls:")
for county_path in age_county_paths:
    print(f"  {county_path}")
print(f"Saved BG age validation: {age_validation_path}")
print(f"Regional persons: {bg_age['persons_final'].sum():,}")

    # 20.0) Distribute persons by occupation at tract level
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.


file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR

occupation_control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_{file_date}.csv"
age_control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_AgeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
audit_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_Person_Controls_audit_{file_date}.csv"
occupation_regional_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"Tractpersons_Regional_OCCU_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
occupation_county_filename_template = "Tractpersons_{county_name}_OCCU_distributed_" + f"{file_date}.csv"
occupation_validation_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"Tract_OCCU_distribution_validation_{file_date}.csv"

occupation_worker_columns = ["OCC_1_MGMT", "OCC_2_SVC", "OCC_3_SALES", "OCC_4_NAT", "OCC_5_PROD", "OCC_6_MIL"]
occupation_output_columns = ["OCC_0", *occupation_worker_columns]
age_columns = ["AGE0004", "AGE0517", "AGE1819", "AGE2024", "AGE2534", "AGE3554", "AGE5564", "AGE65P"]

required_paths = [occupation_control_path, age_control_path, audit_output_path]
missing_paths = [path for path in required_paths if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run cells 1.0, 3.0, and 13.0 first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_tract(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(11)

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def fill_missing_tract_occupation_controls(df: pd.DataFrame, occ_cols: list, tract_col="TRACT") -> pd.DataFrame:
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean[tract_col] = normalize_tract(df_clean[tract_col])
    df_clean[occ_cols] = df_clean[occ_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_clean["county_fips"] = df_clean[tract_col].str[2:5]
    df_clean["OCC_TOTAL"] = df_clean[occ_cols].sum(axis=1)

    empty_mask = df_clean["OCC_TOTAL"].eq(0)
    if not empty_mask.any():
        return df_clean.drop(columns=["OCC_TOTAL"])

    print(f"Found {int(empty_mask.sum()):,} tract(s) with 0 occupation controls. Filling from county/regional distributions.")
    county_totals = df_clean.groupby("county_fips")[occ_cols].sum()
    regional_totals = df_clean[occ_cols].sum()
    for index, row in df_clean[empty_mask].iterrows():
        county_fips = row["county_fips"]
        if county_fips in county_totals.index and county_totals.loc[county_fips].sum() > 0:
            df_clean.loc[index, occ_cols] = county_totals.loc[county_fips].values
        elif regional_totals.sum() > 0:
            df_clean.loc[index, occ_cols] = regional_totals.values
        else:
            df_clean.loc[index, occ_cols] = np.ones(len(occ_cols))

    return df_clean.drop(columns=["OCC_TOTAL"])

def allocate_occupation_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="POPBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    diff = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if diff > 0:
        remainders = exact_values - integer_values
        integer_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
    elif diff < 0:
        subtract_index = integer_values[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
        integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)

occupation_controls = pd.read_csv(occupation_control_path, dtype={"TRACT": "string"})
occupation_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in occupation_controls.columns]
missing_occupation_columns = sorted(set(["TRACT", *occupation_worker_columns]) - set(occupation_controls.columns))
if missing_occupation_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Occupation controls are missing required column(s): {missing_occupation_columns}")
occupation_controls["TRACT"] = normalize_tract(occupation_controls["TRACT"])
occupation_controls = fill_missing_tract_occupation_controls(occupation_controls, occupation_worker_columns, tract_col="TRACT")

age_controls = pd.read_csv(age_control_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
age_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in age_controls.columns]
age_controls["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(age_controls["BlockGroup"])
age_controls["TRACT"] = age_controls["BlockGroup"].str[:11]
age_controls[age_columns] = age_controls[age_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
tract_acs_pop = age_controls.groupby("TRACT", as_index=False)[age_columns].sum()
tract_acs_pop["ACS_POPBASE"] = tract_acs_pop[age_columns].sum(axis=1)

occupation_controls = occupation_controls.merge(tract_acs_pop[["TRACT", "ACS_POPBASE"]], on="TRACT", how="left")
occupation_controls["OCC_WORKERS_TOTAL"] = occupation_controls[occupation_worker_columns].sum(axis=1)
occupation_controls["OCC_0"] = (occupation_controls["ACS_POPBASE"].fillna(0) - occupation_controls["OCC_WORKERS_TOTAL"]).clip(lower=0)
occupation_controls["OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL"] = occupation_controls[occupation_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
for column in occupation_output_columns:
    occupation_controls[f"{column}_SHARE"] = np.where(
        occupation_controls["OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL"].gt(0),
        occupation_controls[column] / occupation_controls["OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL"],
        np.nan,
    )

if "maz" in globals() and {"maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"}.issubset(set(maz.columns)):
    maz_occupation = maz[["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]].copy()
else:
    maz_occupation = pd.read_csv(audit_output_path, dtype={"maz_id": "Int64", "BlockGroup": "string", "county_fips": "string"})[
        ["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]
    ].copy()

maz_occupation["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_occupation["BlockGroup"])
maz_occupation["TRACT"] = maz_occupation["BlockGroup"].str[:11]
maz_occupation["county_fips"] = maz_occupation["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_occupation["PERSONS"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_occupation["PERSONS"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

tract_persons = (
    maz_occupation.groupby(["TRACT", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)["PERSONS"]
    .sum()
    .rename(columns={"PERSONS": "POPBASE"})
    .sort_values("TRACT")
)
share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in occupation_output_columns]
tract_occupation = tract_persons.merge(occupation_controls[["TRACT", "OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="TRACT", how="left")

missing_occupation_controls = tract_occupation[tract_occupation[share_columns].isna().all(axis=1)][["TRACT", "POPBASE"]]
if not missing_occupation_controls.empty:
    county_distribution = occupation_controls.assign(county_fips=occupation_controls["TRACT"].str[2:5]).groupby("county_fips")[occupation_output_columns].sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.div(county_distribution.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)
    regional_distribution = occupation_controls[occupation_output_columns].sum()
    regional_distribution = regional_distribution / regional_distribution.sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.rename(columns={column: f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE" for column in occupation_output_columns}).reset_index()
    tract_occupation = tract_occupation.merge(county_distribution, on="county_fips", how="left")
    for column in occupation_output_columns:
        tract_occupation[f"{column}_SHARE"] = tract_occupation[f"{column}_SHARE"].fillna(tract_occupation[f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_distribution[column])
    print(f"Filled occupation shares for {len(missing_occupation_controls):,} tract record(s) without tract occupation controls.")

for share_column in share_columns:
    tract_occupation[share_column] = tract_occupation[share_column].fillna(1 / len(share_columns))

tract_occupation[occupation_output_columns] = tract_occupation.apply(
    allocate_occupation_mix,
    axis=1,
    share_columns=share_columns,
    output_columns=occupation_output_columns,
)
tract_occupation["persons_final"] = tract_occupation[occupation_output_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
if not tract_occupation["persons_final"].eq(tract_occupation["POPBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = tract_occupation[~tract_occupation["persons_final"].eq(tract_occupation["POPBASE"])][["TRACT", "POPBASE", "persons_final"]]
    raise ValueError(f"Occupation allocation does not sum to POPBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

output_columns = ["TRACT", "persons_final", *occupation_output_columns]
occupation_validation = tract_occupation.merge(
    occupation_controls[["TRACT", "ACS_POPBASE", "OCC_WORKERS_TOTAL", "OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL", *occupation_output_columns]],
    on="TRACT",
    how="left",
    suffixes=("", "_ACS"),
)
occupation_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_OCCUPATION"] = occupation_validation["persons_final"] - occupation_validation[occupation_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
occupation_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_ACS_POPBASE"] = occupation_validation["persons_final"] - occupation_validation["ACS_POPBASE"].fillna(0)

tract_occupation[output_columns].to_csv(occupation_regional_output_path, index=False)
occupation_county_paths = []
for (county_fips, county_name), county_rows in tract_occupation.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], sort=True):
    county_path = OUTPUT_DIR / occupation_county_filename_template.format(county_name=county_name)
    county_rows[output_columns].to_csv(county_path, index=False)
    occupation_county_paths.append(county_path)
occupation_validation.to_csv(occupation_validation_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved regional tract occupation controls: {occupation_regional_output_path}")
print("Saved county tract occupation controls:")
for county_path in occupation_county_paths:
    print(f"  {county_path}")
print(f"Saved tract occupation validation: {occupation_validation_path}")

    # 21.0) Distribute persons by sex at block group level
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.


file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR

sex_control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
audit_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_Person_Controls_audit_{file_date}.csv"
sex_regional_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"BGpersons_Regional_SEX_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
sex_county_filename_template = "BGpersons_{county_name}_SEX_distributed" + f"_{file_date}.csv"
sex_validation_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"BG_SEX_distribution_validation_{file_date}.csv"

sex_output_columns = ["MALE", "FEMALE"]

required_paths = [sex_control_path, audit_output_path]
missing_paths = [path for path in required_paths if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run cells 2.0 and 13.0 first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def allocate_sex_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="POPBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    diff = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if diff > 0:
        remainders = exact_values - integer_values
        integer_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
    elif diff < 0:
        subtract_index = integer_values[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
        integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)

def fill_missing_bg_sex_controls(bg_sex: pd.DataFrame, sex_controls: pd.DataFrame, share_columns: list) -> pd.DataFrame:
    bg_sex = bg_sex.copy()
    missing_sex_controls = bg_sex[bg_sex[share_columns].isna().all(axis=1)][["BlockGroup", "POPBASE"]]
    if missing_sex_controls.empty:
        return bg_sex

    county_distribution = sex_controls.assign(county_fips=sex_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]).groupby("county_fips")[sex_output_columns].sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.div(county_distribution.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)
    regional_distribution = sex_controls[sex_output_columns].sum()
    regional_distribution = regional_distribution / regional_distribution.sum()

    county_distribution = county_distribution.rename(columns={column: f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE" for column in sex_output_columns}).reset_index()
    bg_sex = bg_sex.merge(county_distribution, on="county_fips", how="left")
    for column in sex_output_columns:
        bg_sex[f"{column}_SHARE"] = bg_sex[f"{column}_SHARE"].fillna(bg_sex[f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_distribution[column])

    print(f"Filled sex shares for {len(missing_sex_controls):,} BG record(s) without BG sex controls.")
    return bg_sex

sex_controls = pd.read_csv(sex_control_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
sex_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in sex_controls.columns]
missing_sex_columns = sorted(set(["BlockGroup", *sex_output_columns]) - set(sex_controls.columns))
if missing_sex_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Sex controls are missing required column(s): {missing_sex_columns}")

sex_controls["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(sex_controls["BlockGroup"])
sex_controls[sex_output_columns] = sex_controls[sex_output_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
sex_controls["ACS_SEX_TOTAL"] = sex_controls[sex_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
for column in sex_output_columns:
    sex_controls[f"{column}_SHARE"] = np.where(
        sex_controls["ACS_SEX_TOTAL"].gt(0),
        sex_controls[column] / sex_controls["ACS_SEX_TOTAL"],
        np.nan,
    )

if "maz" in globals() and {"maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"}.issubset(set(maz.columns)):
    maz_sex = maz[["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]].copy()
else:
    maz_sex = pd.read_csv(audit_output_path, dtype={"maz_id": "Int64", "BlockGroup": "string", "county_fips": "string"})[
        ["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]
    ].copy()

maz_sex["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_sex["BlockGroup"])
maz_sex["county_fips"] = maz_sex["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_sex["PERSONS"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_sex["PERSONS"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

bg_persons = (
    maz_sex.groupby(["BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)["PERSONS"]
    .sum()
    .rename(columns={"PERSONS": "POPBASE"})
    .sort_values("BlockGroup")
)
share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in sex_output_columns]
bg_sex = bg_persons.merge(sex_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_SEX_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="BlockGroup", how="left")
bg_sex = fill_missing_bg_sex_controls(bg_sex, sex_controls, share_columns)

for share_column in share_columns:
    bg_sex[share_column] = bg_sex[share_column].fillna(1 / len(share_columns))

bg_sex[sex_output_columns] = bg_sex.apply(
    allocate_sex_mix,
    axis=1,
    share_columns=share_columns,
    output_columns=sex_output_columns,
)
bg_sex["persons_final"] = bg_sex[sex_output_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
if not bg_sex["persons_final"].eq(bg_sex["POPBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = bg_sex[~bg_sex["persons_final"].eq(bg_sex["POPBASE"])][["BlockGroup", "POPBASE", "persons_final"]]
    raise ValueError(f"Sex allocation does not sum to POPBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

output_columns = ["BlockGroup", "persons_final", *sex_output_columns]
sex_validation = bg_sex.merge(
    sex_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_SEX_TOTAL", *sex_output_columns]],
    on="BlockGroup",
    how="left",
    suffixes=("", "_ACS"),
)
sex_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_SEX"] = sex_validation["persons_final"] - sex_validation[sex_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
sex_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_ACS_POPBASE"] = sex_validation["persons_final"] - sex_validation["ACS_SEX_TOTAL"].fillna(0)

bg_sex[output_columns].to_csv(sex_regional_output_path, index=False)
sex_county_paths = []
for (county_fips, county_name), county_rows in bg_sex.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], sort=True):
    county_path = OUTPUT_DIR / sex_county_filename_template.format(county_name=county_name)
    county_rows[output_columns].to_csv(county_path, index=False)
    sex_county_paths.append(county_path)
sex_validation.to_csv(sex_validation_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved regional BG sex controls: {sex_regional_output_path}")
print("Saved county BG sex controls:")
for county_path in sex_county_paths:
    print(f"  {county_path}")
print(f"Saved BG sex validation: {sex_validation_path}")
print(f"Regional persons: {bg_sex['persons_final'].sum():,}")
print(f"Regional male persons: {bg_sex['MALE'].sum():,}")
print(f"Regional female persons: {bg_sex['FEMALE'].sum():,}")

bg_sex[output_columns].head()

errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int) bg_persons = ( maz_sex.groupby(["BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)["PERSONS"] .sum() .rename(columns={"PERSONS": "POPBASE"}) .sort_values("BlockGroup") ) share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in sex_output_columns] bg_sex = bg_persons.merge(sex_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_SEX_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="BlockGroup", how="left") bg_sex = fill_missing_bg_sex_controls(bg_sex, sex_controls, share_columns) for share_column in share_columns: bg_sex[share_column] = bg_sex[share_column].fillna(1 / bg_sex[sex_output_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int) if not bg_sex["persons_final"].eq(bg_sex["POPBASE"]).all(): bad_rows = bg_sex[~bg_sex["persons_final"].eq(bg_sex["POPBASE"])][["BlockGroup", sex_validation = bg_sex.merge( sex_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_SEX_TOTAL", *sex_output_columns]], on="BlockGroup", how="left", suffixes=("", "_ACS"), ) sex_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_SEX"] = index=False) sex_county_paths.append(county_path) sex_validation.to_csv(sex_validation_path, index=False) print(f"Saved regional BG sex controls: {sex_regional_output_path}") print("Saved county BG control_totals_output_paths = {

    "BlockGroup": OUTPUT_DIR / f"control_totals_BlockGroup_NonGQ_{file_date}.csv",

}

}

}

bg_hhsize_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bghouseholds_Regional_HHSIZE_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
bg_haschild_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bghouseholds_Regional_HASCHILD_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
bg_hhinc_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bghouseholds_Regional_HHINC_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
bg_hht_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bghouseholds_Regional_HHT_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
bg_age_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bgpersons_Regional_AGE_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
bg_sex_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"BGpersons_Regional_SEX_distributed_{file_date}.csv"

tract_hhworker_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"Tracthouseholds_Regional_HHWorker_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
tract_occupation_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"Tractpersons_Regional_OCCU_distributed_{file_date}.csv"

required_paths = [
    maz_household_path,
    maz_person_path,
    bg_hhsize_path,
    bg_haschild_path,
    bg_hhinc_path,
    bg_hht_path,
    bg_age_path,
    bg_sex_path,
    tract_hhworker_path,
    tract_occupation_path,
]
missing_paths = [path for path in required_paths if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run the distribution cells first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def normalize_tract(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(11)

def read_control(path: str, key_column: str, id_kind: str, columns: list = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={key_column: "string"})
    df.columns = [column.strip() for column in df.columns]
    if key_column not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"{path} is missing required key column {key_column}.")
    if columns is not None:
        missing_columns = sorted(set([key_column, *columns]) - set(df.columns))
        if missing_columns:
            raise KeyError(f"{path} is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")
        df = df[[key_column, *columns]].copy()
    if id_kind == "maz":
        df[key_column] = pd.to_numeric(df[key_column], errors="coerce")
        df = df.dropna(subset=[key_column])
        df[key_column] = df[key_column].astype(int)
    elif id_kind == "bg":
        df[key_column] = normalize_blockgroup(df[key_column])
    elif id_kind == "tract":
        df[key_column] = normalize_tract(df[key_column])
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported id_kind: {id_kind}")
    value_columns = [column for column in df.columns if column != key_column]
    df[value_columns] = df[value_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).round().astype(int)
    return df.groupby(key_column, as_index=False)[value_columns].sum()

def merge_controls(base: pd.DataFrame, add: pd.DataFrame, key_column: str, keep_columns: list) -> pd.DataFrame:
    add_columns = [key_column, *keep_columns]
    missing_columns = sorted(set(add_columns) - set(add.columns))
    if missing_columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Input control is missing merge column(s): {missing_columns}")
    return base.merge(add[add_columns], on=key_column, how="outer")

def fill_control_values(df: pd.DataFrame, key_column: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()
    value_columns = [column for column in df.columns if column != key_column]
    df[value_columns] = df[value_columns].fillna(0).round().astype(int)
    return df.sort_values(key_column).reset_index(drop=True)

# MAZ control totals: household base and person base at MAZ level.
maz_households = read_control(maz_household_path, "maz_id", "maz", ["SF", "MF", "HHBASE"])
maz_persons = read_control(maz_person_path, "maz_id", "maz", ["POPBASE"])
maz_control_totals = fill_control_values(maz_households.merge(maz_persons, on="maz_id", how="outer"), "maz_id")
maz_control_totals = maz_control_totals[["maz_id", "SF", "MF", "HHBASE", "POPBASE"]]

# Block group control totals: horizontally merge household and person distributions.
bg_hhsize = read_control(bg_hhsize_path, "BlockGroup", "bg", ["hhs", "hhs1", "hhs2", "hhs3", "hhs4", "hhs5", "hhs6"])
bg_haschild = read_control(bg_haschild_path, "BlockGroup", "bg", ["hhs", "HASCHILD_YES", "HASCHILD_NO"])
bg_hhinc = read_control(bg_hhinc_path, "BlockGroup", "bg", ["hhs", "HHINC000_025", "HHINC025_050", "HHINC050_075", "HHINC075_100", "HHINC100_125", "HHINC125_150", "HHINC150_200", "HHINC200P"])
bg_hht = read_control(bg_hht_path, "BlockGroup", "bg", ["hhs", "familyhhs", "nonfamilyhhs"])
bg_age_columns = ["AGE_0_4", "AGE_5_17", "AGE_18_19", "AGE_20_24", "AGE_25_34", "AGE_35_54", "AGE_55_64", "AGE_65P"]
bg_age = read_control(bg_age_path, "BlockGroup", "bg", ["persons_final", *bg_age_columns])
bg_sex = read_control(bg_sex_path, "BlockGroup", "bg", ["persons_final", "MALE", "FEMALE"])

bg_control_totals = bg_hhsize.rename(columns={"hhs": "HHBASE"})
bg_control_totals = merge_controls(bg_control_totals, bg_haschild, "BlockGroup", ["HASCHILD_YES", "HASCHILD_NO"])
bg_control_totals = merge_controls(bg_control_totals, bg_hhinc, "BlockGroup", ["HHINC000_025", "HHINC025_050", "HHINC050_075", "HHINC075_100", "HHINC100_125", "HHINC125_150", "HHINC150_200", "HHINC200P"])
bg_control_totals = merge_controls(bg_control_totals, bg_hht, "BlockGroup", ["familyhhs", "nonfamilyhhs"])
bg_control_totals = merge_controls(bg_control_totals, bg_age.rename(columns={"persons_final": "POPBASE"}), "BlockGroup", ["POPBASE", *bg_age_columns])
bg_control_totals = merge_controls(bg_control_totals, bg_sex, "BlockGroup", ["MALE", "FEMALE"])
bg_control_totals = fill_control_values(bg_control_totals, "BlockGroup")
bg_control_totals = bg_control_totals[[
    "BlockGroup",

    "hhs4",
    "hhs5",

    "HHINC050_075",

    "HHINC100_125",
    "HHINC125_150",
    "HHINC150_200",
    "HHINC200P",
    "familyhhs",
    "nonfamilyhhs",
    "AGE_0_4",
    "AGE_5_17",
    "AGE_18_19",
    "AGE_20_24",
    "AGE_25_34",
    "AGE_35_54",
    "AGE_55_64",
    "AGE_65P",
    "MALE",
    "FEMALE",
]]

# Tract control totals: horizontally merge household-worker and occupation distributions.
tract_hhworker = read_control(tract_hhworker_path, "TRACT", "tract", ["hhs", "HHWRK_0", "HHWRK_1", "HHWRK_2", "HHWRK_3PLUS"])
tract_occupation = read_control(tract_occupation_path, "TRACT", "tract", ["persons_final", "OCC_0", "OCC_1_MGMT", "OCC_2_SVC", "OCC_3_SALES", "OCC_4_NAT", "OCC_5_PROD", "OCC_6_MIL"])
tract_control_totals = tract_hhworker.rename(columns={"hhs": "HHBASE"})
tract_control_totals = merge_controls(tract_control_totals, tract_occupation.rename(columns={"persons_final": "POPBASE"}), "TRACT", ["POPBASE", "OCC_0", "OCC_1_MGMT", "OCC_2_SVC", "OCC_3_SALES", "OCC_4_NAT", "OCC_5_PROD", "OCC_6_MIL"])
tract_control_totals = fill_control_values(tract_control_totals, "TRACT")
tract_control_totals = tract_control_totals[["TRACT", "HHBASE", "POPBASE", "HHWRK_0", "HHWRK_1", "HHWRK_2", "HHWRK_3PLUS", "OCC_0", "OCC_1_MGMT", "OCC_2_SVC", "OCC_3_SALES", "OCC_4_NAT", "OCC_5_PROD", "OCC_6_MIL"]]

validation_rows = []
def add_validation(geography: str, control_name: str, total: int):
    validation_rows.append({"geography": geography, "control_name": control_name, "total": int(total)})

add_validation("MAZ", "HHBASE", maz_control_totals["HHBASE"].sum())
add_validation("MAZ", "SF_PLUS_MF", maz_control_totals[["SF", "MF"]].sum(axis=1).sum())
add_validation("MAZ", "POPBASE", maz_control_totals["POPBASE"].sum())
add_validation("BlockGroup", "HHBASE", bg_control_totals["HHBASE"].sum())
add_validation("BlockGroup", "HHSIZE_SUM", bg_control_totals[["hhs1", "hhs2", "hhs3", "hhs4", "hhs5", "hhs6"]].sum(axis=1).sum())
add_validation("BlockGroup", "HASCHILD_SUM", bg_control_totals[["HASCHILD_YES", "HASCHILD_NO"]].sum(axis=1).sum())
add_validation("BlockGroup", "HHINC_SUM", bg_control_totals[["HHINC000_025", "HHINC025_050", "HHINC050_075", "HHINC075_100", "HHINC100_125", "HHINC125_150", "HHINC150_200", "HHINC200P"]].sum(axis=1).sum())
add_validation("BlockGroup", "HHT_SUM", bg_control_totals[["familyhhs", "nonfamilyhhs"]].sum(axis=1).sum())
add_validation("BlockGroup", "POPBASE", bg_control_totals["POPBASE"].sum())
add_validation("BlockGroup", "AGE_SUM", bg_control_totals[bg_age_columns].sum(axis=1).sum())
add_validation("BlockGroup", "SEX_SUM", bg_control_totals[["MALE", "FEMALE"]].sum(axis=1).sum())
add_validation("TRACT", "HHBASE", tract_control_totals["HHBASE"].sum())
add_validation("TRACT", "HHWRK_SUM", tract_control_totals[["HHWRK_0", "HHWRK_1", "HHWRK_2", "HHWRK_3PLUS"]].sum(axis=1).sum())
add_validation("TRACT", "POPBASE", tract_control_totals["POPBASE"].sum())
add_validation("TRACT", "OCC_SUM", tract_control_totals[["OCC_0", "OCC_1_MGMT", "OCC_2_SVC", "OCC_3_SALES", "OCC_4_NAT", "OCC_5_PROD", "OCC_6_MIL"]].sum(axis=1).sum())
validation = pd.DataFrame(validation_rows)

maz_control_totals.to_csv(control_totals_output_paths["MAZ"], index=False)
bg_control_totals.to_csv(control_totals_output_paths["BlockGroup"], index=False)

maz_control_totals.to_csv(final_control_totals_output_paths["MAZ"], index=False)

validation.to_csv(control_totals_validation_path, index=False)
